content:
This 7-day content strategy for **@garvit.irl** focuses on high-value AI utility, mindset shifts for Indian entrepreneurs, and building a relatable personal brand.

---

## DAY 1 — Monday
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** The "Anti-Subscription" AI Hack (Based on your Speed AI script)
**Post Time:** 7:15 PM IST
**Hook:** Stop paying for AI subscriptions right now.
**Trigger Word:** FREE

## DAY 2 — Tuesday
**Format:** Carousel
**Topic:** Why you feel like a fraud (Mindset shift for creators)
**Post Time:** 6:45 PM IST
**Hook:** "Kya kar raha hai?" – The voice in your head that stops you from starting.
**Trigger Word:** START

## DAY 3 — Wednesday
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** Build a "Second Brain" using Notion & AI
**Post Time:** 7:30 PM IST
**Hook:** I stopped relying on my memory and started using this AI system instead.
**Trigger Word:** SYSTEM

## DAY 4 — Thursday
**Format:** Carousel
**Topic:** 3 AI Tools I use to automate my content workflow (Save 10+ hours/week)
**Post Time:** 7:00 PM IST
**Hook:** My content creation process used to take 5 hours, now it takes 30 minutes.
**Trigger Word:** TOOLS

## DAY 5 — Friday
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** The "King Kohli" Mindset (Based on your I am the best script)
**Post Time:** 8:00 PM IST
**Hook:** Why Ronaldo, Kohli, and SRK all say the same 3 words before they perform.
**Trigger Word:** MINDSET

## DAY 6 — Saturday
**Format:** Carousel
**Topic:** How to build a side hustle using AI while working a 9-5
**Post Time:** 6:30 PM IST
**Hook:** You don't need to quit your job to start a business in 2024.
**Trigger Word:** GROWTH

## DAY 7 — Sunday
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** Weekly AI News Roundup (What happened in AI this week that actually matters)
**Post Time:** 7:00 PM IST
**Hook:** Too busy to keep up with AI? Here’s the only update you need for this week.
**Trigger Word:** UPDATE
